Page: One Summer Love. Sentence: One Summer Love, originally titled Dragonfly, is a 1976 romantic drama film directed by Gilbert Cates from a screenplay by N. Richard Nash.
Page: One Summer Love. Sentence: It stars Beau Bridges and Susan Sarandon and features Mildred Dunnock and Ann Wedgeworth.
Page: Ann Wedgeworth. Sentence: Ann Wedgeworth (born January 21, 1934) is an American character actress, known for her roles as Lana Shields in "Three's Company" and Merleen Elldridge in "Evening Shade".
Page: Stephen J. Lawrence. Sentence: He has composed more than 300 songs and scores for "Sesame Street", resulting in three Emmy Awards for Outstanding Achievement in Music Direction and Composition; composed the title song and four others for Marlo Thomas's "Free to Be... You and Me", the landmark million-selling record, book and Emmy Award- and Peabody Award-winning ABC television special; composed the million-selling Gold Record "You Take My Breath Away"; scored the Robert De Niro movie "Bang the Drum Slowly" and the cult horror classic "Alice, Sweet Alice", which won the music award at the Paris International Festival of Fantasy and Science Fiction; composed score for "One Summer Love", 1976, a.k.a. Facts:
- One Summer Love, originally titled Dragonfly, is a 1976 romantic drama film directed by Gilbert Cates from a screenplay by N. Richard Nash.
- One Summer Love stars Beau Bridges and Susan Sarandon and features Mildred Dunnock and Ann Wedgeworth.
- Ann Wedgeworth was born on January 21, 1934, and is an American character actress.
- Ann Wedgeworth is known for playing Lana Shields in Three's Company and Merleen Elldridge in Evening Shade.
- Stephen J. Lawrence composed more than 300 songs and scores for Sesame Street and won three Emmy Awards for Outstanding Achievement in Music Direction and Composition for that work.
- Stephen J. Lawrence composed the title song and four other songs for Marlo Thomas's Free to Be... You and Me.
- Free to Be... You and Me became a million-selling record, a book, and an ABC television special that won Emmy and Peabody awards.
- Stephen J. Lawrence composed the million-selling Gold Record You Take My Breath Away.
- Stephen J. Lawrence scored the Robert De Niro film Bang the Drum Slowly and Alice, Sweet Alice, whose music won an award at the Paris International Festival of Fantasy and Science Fiction.
- Stephen J. Lawrence composed the score for One Summer Love in 1976, and that film was also known as Dragonfly.
- In 1989, Stephen J. Lawrence composed the songs and score for the live-action movie musical Red Riding Hood, starring Isabella Rossellini and Craig T. Nelson, with lyrics by Michael Korie.
- Stephen J. Lawrence composed songs for the live-action movie musical The Emperor's New Clothes, starring Sid Caesar and Robert Morse.
- Stephen J. Lawrence composed the songs and score for The Tale of Peter Rabbit, an HBO animated musical starring Carol Burnett with lyrics by Sheldon Harnick.
